disclaimerStatement.title: Studio feel first, booking system if needed.
disclaimerStatement.description: This page describes presences for studios: images, services, the way to an appointment. For automatic online booking with a calendar and payment, a dedicated booking system is often the better basis. We tell you openly what suits your plan. And: nobody can seriously guarantee Google rankings.

items.question: How much does a website for a beauty or lash studio cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: number of pages, image material, languages and the features you want. Our packages and prices give you a guide. You receive a concrete quote after a short conversation, with no obligation.

items.question: Do you build websites for studios in Münster and the surrounding area?
items.answer: Yes. We build websites for studios and salons in Münster, the Münsterland region and across Germany. Coordination and delivery work conveniently online.

items.question: Is Lash Studio Demo a real client project?
items.answer: No. Lash Studio Demo is a fictional studio that we built as a concept project to show our work on a beauty topic. Concept projects are labelled as such in the portfolio.

items.question: Can clients book an appointment online?
items.answer: In the concept, the request goes through a ready-made WhatsApp message. A booking system with a calendar is possible as an extension; we discuss what suits your studio.

items.question: What material do I need to get started?
items.answer: Ideally photos of your work and the studio, a logo, the list of services and contact details. If something is missing, we clarify in a conversation how to proceed.
